text.alertCardDropped: The card was unlinked — renewal is manual from now on.
text.alertNodeMemory: 🔥 Node running out of memory: {node} {percent}% in use.
text.alertRefundCanceled: YooKassa declined the automatic refund — refund it by hand.
text.alertRefundDiscountUsed: Another payment had already used the promo discount — refunded automatically.
text.alertRefundLapsed: Device places for a lapsed subscription — refunded automatically.
text.alertRefundManual: Refunded from the YooKassa dashboard — the access it paid for is taken back.
text.alertRefundOrphan: A payment without an account — refunded automatically.
text.alertRefundPartial: A partial refund — the period is untouched, review it by hand.
text.alreadyLinked: ⚠️ This Telegram is already linked to another account That account has a subscription or payments, so I cannot move the chat myself. To link Telegram to the account on the site, unlink it here first: “⚙️ More” → “🔌 Unlink” (that account needs an email for this). Then send the code again — it still works.
text.appsIntro: 📱 Apps Pick yours — I will send the install link and the one that connects it. Need WireGuard for a router or a separate app? Use the “🔑 WireGuard config” button below.
text.appsPasteClashMeta: Open Clash Meta, go to Profiles, tap “+” → URL, paste the link and save. Then select that profile.
text.appsPasteHiddify: Open Hiddify, tap “+” (new profile) and choose “Add from clipboard”.
text.appsPasteIncy: Open INCY, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard — the subscription arrives with every server.
text.appsPasteNekobox: Open NekoBox, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard — the link is added as a subscription.
text.appsPasteStreisand: Open Streisand, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard — the link is added as a subscription.
text.appsPasteV2rayng: Open v2rayNG, tap “+” and choose import from clipboard. Then tap “Update subscription” in the ⋮ menu to load the servers.
text.appsSteps: How to connect 1. Copy the link with the button below. 2. {how} 3. Pick a country and connect. If it will not connect, try VLESS for the same country.
text.autoRenewNeedsCard: 🔄 Auto-renewal No card is linked, so there is nothing to charge. Link one in your account on the site and the subscription will renew itself.
text.autoRenewOff: 🔄 Auto-renewal is off Access ends on {date} and nothing will be charged.
text.autoRenewOn: 🔄 Auto-renewal is on The next period is charged to your card automatically — nothing to do.
text.autoRenewTrial: 🔄 Auto-renewal There is nothing to renew during the free day — it is never charged. Subscribe with the “Renew” button: the paid period starts right after the free day, so you keep the time that is left.
text.autoRenewUnavailable: 🔄 Auto-renewal Automatic charges are not available right now — renew by hand with the “Renew” button.
text.broadcastAsk: 📣 Broadcast Who should get this message? It goes out as a copy, without a “Forwarded” label.
text.broadcastBusy: ⏳ The previous broadcast is still running — wait for its report.
text.broadcastNobody: 📣 Nobody to send to — this audience is empty.
text.broadcastReport: 📣 Broadcast finished ✅ Delivered: {delivered} 🚫 Blocked the bot: {blocked} ⚠️ Not delivered: {failed}
text.broadcastSourceMissing: ⚠️ The broadcast stopped: the original message was deleted.
text.broadcastStarted: 📣 Broadcast started Recipients: {count}. A report follows when it is done.
text.broadcastUsage: 📣 To broadcast a message, reply to it with /broadcast.
text.chargeFailed: ❌ The card could not be charged Access works until {date}. Renew by hand — another card works too. We will not try to charge again this period.
text.chatId: 🆔 This chat’s ID: {id} Put it into TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID to have support requests and alerts arrive here.
text.checkoutAbandoned: 💳 The payment did not go through You started subscribing, but the payment was not completed. If something went wrong, try again — it takes a minute.
text.checkoutDiscount: 🏷 {percent}% off with promo code {code} — {price} RUB without it.
text.checkoutIntro: 💳 Payment: {plan} Amount: {amount} RUB. Access opens the moment the payment goes through — I will message you here.
text.checkoutTerms: By paying you accept the terms of service.
text.checkoutWait: ⏳ The payment is already being created — give it a few seconds.
text.choosePlan: 💳 Pick a term The longer it is, the cheaper the month. Every plan has every country and every protocol: Hysteria2, VLESS + Reality and WireGuard.
text.choosePlanStacked: 💳 Extend your subscription The new term is added to the current one — the days you have left are kept. The longer it is, the cheaper the month.
text.codeInvalid: ⚠️ That code did not work It is unknown, already used or expired. Get a new one on the site, in the “Telegram” section.
text.consentLine: By using the bot you consent to the processing of your personal data.
text.deleteAsk:
🗑️ Delete the account?
The subscription stops with no refund for the time left, devices disconnect and the link stops working.
We will not be able to restore it.
text.deletePaymentPending: ⏳ The account cannot be deleted right now A payment on it has not finished yet. Wait until it goes through or is canceled — usually a few minutes — and try again.
text.deleted: The account is deleted. Thank you for being with us 👋
text.deviceAdded: 📲 New device {name} Devices: {count} of {limit}. Not you? Remove it in “Devices” and change the link with /rotate.
text.deviceBlocked: ⛔ Device not connected {name} is asking for servers, but every place is taken: {limit} of {limit}. Remove an old device or add a place, then refresh the subscription in the app.
text.deviceGone: That device is no longer on the list — it seems it was removed already.
text.deviceRemoveAsk: Remove {name}? The app on it stops connecting within a few minutes and its place frees up. If the app refreshes the subscription again it takes the place back — so remove the subscription in the app first.
text.deviceRemoved: ✅ Device removed — its keys stop working within a few minutes.
text.devicesAdded: ✅ Places added The new limit is already in effect, and the link stays the same.
text.devicesEmpty: None yet. A device shows up here once its app refreshes the subscription for the first time.
text.devicesExtra: Need more places? Each is {price} RUB, paid once.
text.devicesFull: No more places can be added
text.devicesIntro: 📲 Extra places: +{count} Amount: {amount} RUB. The limit grows the moment the payment goes through — I will message you here. By paying you accept the terms of service.
text.devicesNeedPaid: Extra places come with a paid subscription only — the free day does not count.
text.devicesShrunk: ⚠️ The device limit went down to {limit} No longer getting servers: {names}. Add places or choose which device to remove.
text.endingSoon: ⏳ The subscription ends on {date} Renew it so your access does not stop.
text.expired: 🔒 The subscription has ended Access is off. Subscribe to bring it back — the link in your app starts working again.
text.failed: 😵 Something went wrong. Please try again in a minute.
text.giftCheckoutAbandoned: 🎁 The gift is not paid for You started buying a gift subscription, but the payment was not completed. You can get back to it on the site, on the “Subscription” tab.
text.giftPurchased: 🎁 Gift paid Gift code: {code} — {days} of subscription. Send it to whoever you are giving it to: they enter it on the site when signing up, or in their account under “Have a promo code?”. All your gifts and their status are in your account on the site.
text.groupOnly: 🔒 I only work in a private chat — that is where your subscription and links live, and they are not for others to see. Message me directly.
text.help:
❓ Help Everything is on the buttons below. The ones you need most: 🚀 Connect — the link for your app 📱 Apps — what to install, how to connect, and a WireGuard config 📊 Subscription — term, plan, renewal 📲 Devices — remove one or add a place 💳 Subscribe or Renew — pay for access 🎁 Free day — one day for free
The rest is under “⚙️ More” 💬 Support — get in touch with us 🤝 Invite a friend — bonus days for friends 🔄 Auto-renewal — turn automatic renewal on or off 🔁 New link — if the old one got into the wrong hands 🌐 Website — a one-time sign-in to your account 🌍 Language — switch language 🔌 Unlink — disconnect this chat from the account 🗑️ Delete — delete the account and its subscription
text.helpSupport: Something not working? Press “💬 Support” or just write here — we answer in this chat.
text.helpSupportOffline: Something not working? Write to support on the site.
text.inactive: 📊 No active subscription Subscribe and access opens the moment you pay.
text.inviteCode: 🎟 Promo code: {code} A friend enters it when signing up on the site — or just opens a link below.
text.inviteFootnote: The bonus comes once per friend, for their first payment. No more than {days} per 30 days.
text.inviteShareText: I use GnomeVPN — a fast VPN with no speed limits. Take my link and get bonus days on your first payment.
text.inviteStats: 📊 Came by your link: {invited} · paid: {rewarded} · earned: {days}
text.inviteTitle: 🤝 Invite a friend Share your link: your friend gets bonus days on their first payment, and you get days on your subscription as soon as they pay.
text.lapsed: 🔒 Your subscription has ended Subscribe to bring access back — the link in your app starts working again.
text.legacyRetired: 🔐 Every device now has keys of its own If a device stopped connecting, open the VPN app on it and refresh the subscription.
text.linkIntro: 🚀 Your subscription link Copy it and add it to your app:
text.linkWarning: Do not forward the link to anyone — it is as good as access to your subscription. If it leaked, change it with /rotate.
text.linked: ✅ This chat is linked to your account Everything is managed from here now, with the buttons below.
text.moreTitle: ⚙️ More Support and help, invites and bonus days, signing in on the site, auto-renewal and a new subscription link, language, and unlinking the chat or deleting the account.
text.moreTitleNoAccess: ⚙️ More Support and help, invites and bonus days, signing in on the site, language, and unlinking the chat or deleting the account. Auto-renewal and a new subscription link show up here once you have access.
text.noSubscription: 🔒 No subscription yet Try a free day or subscribe straight away.
text.notLinked: 🔌 This chat is not linked to an account Press /start to create one, or send the code from the “Telegram” page of your account on the site to link an existing one.
text.noticeInvite: 🤝 Invite a friend: when they pay for {plan}, you get +{referrer} and they get +{friend}.
text.offersOff: 🔕 Offers are off Discounts and special offers will no longer come here or by email. Messages about payments, access and devices keep coming as before.
text.offersOn: 🔔 Offers are on Now and then we will send discounts and special offers — here and by email. Turn them off any time with /offers or the button under such a message.
text.paid: 🎉 Payment received The subscription is active until {date}. Press “Connect” to get your link.
text.promoCreatedLink: A link to share — the code fills itself in at sign-up: {link}
text.promoNotFound: {code} is not one of your codes — check the spelling.
text.promoProblemCodeFormat: A code is {min} to {max} latin letters and digits.
text.promoProblemCodeLikeFriend: That code looks like a friend code (8 characters without 0, O, 1, I, L) — change its length or add one of those letters.
text.promoProblemCodeLikeGift: That code looks like a gift code (12 characters without 0, O, 1, I, L) — change its length or add one of those letters.
text.promoProblemDaysRange: Bonus days are a whole number from {min} to {max}.
text.promoProblemExpiryInvalid: The date in until must look like YYYY-MM-DD.
text.promoProblemExpiryPast: The date in until has already passed.
text.promoProblemMaxUsesRange: uses is a whole number from {min} to {max}, or leave it out.
text.promoProblemPercentRange: A discount is a whole percent from {min} to {max}.
text.promoStopped: ⏹ Promo code {code} stopped — new redemptions will fail, the ones already made stay.
text.promoTaken: {code} is already taken — pick another one.
text.promoUnknown: I did not understand that. Here is how it works:
text.promoUsage: 🏷 Promo codes Create: /promo CODE 20% — a discount on one payment, /promo CODE 7d — bonus days. Optionally add uses=100 — how many times it can be used, and until=2026-12-31 — the last day it works (Moscow time). Stop: /promo off CODE.
text.referralBanked: 🤝 Your friend subscribed You got +{days}. You have no paid period right now, so the days wait and are added to your next payment.
text.referralBonus: 🎁 Invite bonus +{days} added to your subscription — thanks for coming by a friend's link. Invite yours, and the bonus is yours too.
text.referralInvalid: This invite link was not found — it may have a typo.
text.referralRewarded: 🤝 Your friend subscribed You got +{days}, the subscription is active until {date}. Thanks for recommending GnomeVPN!
text.referralSelf: This is your own invite link — send it to your friends 🙂
text.referralUnavailable: The invite did not apply: it only works for a new account that has not paid for a subscription yet.
text.referralWelcome: 🎁 A friend invited you Your first payment comes with bonus days — up to +{days} on a yearly plan.
text.refreshHint: No servers in your app? Open it and refresh the subscription.
text.renewManual: No card is linked — renew by hand with the “Renew” button.
text.renewSoon: 🔄 Renewal coming up The subscription runs until {date}. A day before that we charge {amount} RUB to the card {card} and it renews.
text.rotateAsk: 🔁 Change the link? The old one stops working and every app connected through it is removed — the new link has to be added to each app again. WireGuard configs are not affected.
text.rotateDone: 🔁 The link is new The old one no longer works and the apps that used it are removed. Add this one to each app again:
text.start: 👋 GnomeVPN — a fast VPN with no speed limits. 🔒 A protected connection on any network — at home, in a café, on the road 🌍 Servers in several countries to choose from 📱 iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS and TVs Your account was created from this chat — nothing to fill in. Start with a free day or subscribe with the buttons below. The same account opens on the site {site} — “🌐 Website” under “⚙️ More” signs you in.
text.supportAck: 📨 Passed to support — we will answer here.
text.supportAnswerBlocked: 🚫 Not delivered: the user blocked the bot.
text.supportAnswerFailed: ⚠️ The answer was not delivered — try again.
text.supportIntro: 💬 Support Tell us what happened — your next messages go to support: text, screenshots, files, voice notes. The answer arrives right here, in this chat.
text.supportNoAccount: 🔌 Chat not linked to an account · 🌍 {locale}
text.supportOffline: 💬 Support Write to us — we answer as soon as we can.
text.supportOfflineSite: 💬 Support Write to support on the site — the contacts are at the bottom of every page.
text.supportSlowDown: ⏳ That is a lot of messages in a row. Give it a few minutes — we will read everything that already arrived.
text.trialEndingSoon: ⏳ The free day is almost over Subscribe so your access does not stop.
text.trialEnds: You can subscribe right now with the “Renew” button — the paid period starts right after the free day, so you keep the time that is left.
text.trialGranted: 🎁 Your free day has started 24 hours of full access: every country, every protocol (Hysteria2, VLESS + Reality, WireGuard), no speed limits. Press “Connect” to get your link.
text.trialHasAccess:
Your access is already on — no free day needed.

Press “Connect” for your app link.
text.trialNeedsEmail: Confirm your email on the site first — the message is already on its way to the address on your account.
text.trialUnavailable:
The free day is already used — it is given once.

Press “Subscribe” to get a subscription.
text.trialWinBackOffer: 🎁 {percent}% off a subscription Your free day is over. If GnomeVPN worked for you, subscribe with {percent}% off. No promo code to type — the discount applies by itself.
text.unlinkAsk: 🔌 Unlink this chat? The subscription and access stay; you can still sign in to your account with your email.
text.unlinkNoEmail: 🔌 This chat cannot be unlinked yet This account was created in Telegram and has no other way in. Unlink it now and the subscription stays, but nothing can open it. Open your account with “🌐 Website” first, add an email on the “Settings” tab and set a password with “Send me a link” — then unlinking is safe.
text.unlinked: This chat is unlinked. The subscription and access are untouched — come back any time.
text.websiteIntro: 🌐 Sign in on the site The link works once and lives for 10 minutes — do not forward it to anyone.
text.welcomeBack: 👋 Welcome back! Everything is on the buttons below.
text.winBackOffer: 🎁 {percent}% off — just for you Your subscription has ended, but you can come back any time: your next payment is {percent}% off. No promo code to type — the discount applies by itself.
text.winBackReminder: ⏳ Your {percent}% discount is still waiting It applies to your next subscription payment by itself — nothing to type.
text.wireguardAdded: 📲 New WireGuard config {name} Devices: {count} of {limit}. Not you? Delete the config in “Devices”.
text.wireguardAllDown: Every WireGuard server is down right now. Try again in a few minutes.
text.wireguardConfigs: Your configs — tap one to get its file again. To delete a config, use “📲 Devices”.
text.wireguardCreated: ✅ Config “{name}” is ready — the file is below.
text.wireguardFull: Every place is taken: remove a device you no longer use in “📲 Devices”, or add a place.
text.wireguardHowAny: Open the file in AmneziaVPN, WireGuard or WireSock — or upload it to a router.
text.wireguardHowComputer: On Windows, import the file into WireSock Secure Connect; on macOS and Linux, into the WireGuard app.
text.wireguardHowPhone: Tap the file and open it in AmneziaVPN or WireGuard — or import it in the app with “+”.
text.wireguardHowRouter: Upload the file to the router’s WireGuard client — Keenetic, OpenWrt, MikroTik.
text.wireguardIntro: 🔑 WireGuard config A file for a router or a WireGuard app — AmneziaVPN, WireSock, WireGuard. One config is one device and one country, and it takes a place in your limit: {count} of {limit} in use.
text.wireguardKindAsk: New config: {server} Which device is it for? It sets the name and the tip on how to open the file.
text.wireguardNoServers: No server runs WireGuard yet — check back later.
text.wireguardNotSent: The config is created, but the file did not go through. Open /wireguard and tap the config to get the file again.
text.wireguardNote: WireGuard is easy to recognise and fails more often than the other protocols, especially on mobile networks. If a config will not connect, use an app with your subscription — “🚀 Connect”.
text.wireguardUnavailable: This server is down right now — pick another country or try again in a few minutes.
text.wireguardWait: ⏳ The config is already being created — give it a few seconds.
